status.d: Minor Industrial is permitted; Major Industrial only where it existed on 1 January 2024. A large data centre is treated by the City as Major Industrial. A smaller one whose noise, emissions and fuel or battery hazards stay inside the site could be argued as Minor Industrial — the Development Planner decides. A large data centre here needs a rezoning to IH.

notes: Noise: needs a plant room: solid walls, roof RW 47 or better, gaps sealed, louvres of at least 6–27 dB by band (NSW 2021 Table 4-5): −25 dB (arch_nz_nswDcNoise). Without it: about 72–75 dBA (quieter–standard unit rating) at the property line of 8720 106A AVENUE NW (RM), 77 m away; limit 50 dBA at night (Bylaw 14600 s. 20(1)).

Noise: with the standard (louder) unit rating the plant would exceed the 50 dBA night limit at the property line of 8720 106A AVENUE NW (RM) (about 47–50 dBA (quieter–standard unit rating), Bylaw 14600 s. 20(1)); 3 lots in all. With the quieter rating it is under, so this is not blocked: standard units would need low-noise chillers (Trane RTAF 280 LN, maker claim) + a plant room to the NSW 2021 terms (−25 dB).

loadingNeed.basis: 2 loading spaces for 17,652 m² of floor area (Table 7.2). Each 9.0 × 3.0–3.3 m, 4.0 m clear, wholly on site, with no backing onto streets or alleys (s. 5.80 subs. 7). Aisle: Vancouver's 6.1 m used as an assumption.

s.src: Air-cooled chillers with free-cooling coils (air cooling): an air-cooled hall needs chilled water at about 13 °C or warmer (NREL for DOE FEMP, Best Practices Guide 2024, s. 5.2.1), and a dry cooler cannot cool water below the outdoor air (rated units leave it 3–11 K above), so chillers carry the full load in summer. Basis unit: Vertiv Liebert AFC FIZ135, 12.14 × 2.36 m, 2.90 m high, 1,489 kW at 35 °C ambient, 27.8 → 18.9 °C fluid, 30% glycol, with oversized free-cooling coils (Vertiv SL-71060 R09/24, "Preliminary data"; manufacturer claim). Chosen 29 Oct 2026 as the unit nearest the middle of …

lines: Sized for 29 MW of servers: heat to reject ≈ 29 × PUE 1.55 = 44.6 MW at peak.
30 air-cooled chillers carry it; with spares, 31. Placed: 0 on the roof, 0 in the yard.
